thread.title: UnitedHealth Group, AT&T, Canopy Growth: 'Mad Money' Lightning Round

author: Scott Rutt
title: UnitedHealth Group, AT&T, Canopy Growth: 'Mad Money' Lightning Round
text:
Here's what Jim Cramer had to say about some of the stocks during the Mad Money Lightning Round :
UnitedHealth Group ( UNH ) : "I think the stock is a buy. "
Cabot Oil & Gas ( COG ) : "I'm going to have to say no thanks."
Canopy Growth ( CGC ) : "If you want a cannabis stock, this is the one you want to own."
AT&T ( T ) : "I like this 7% yielder. This is an opportunity."
